hero.title:
Care starts
around the table.
hero.description: We are building a community feeding effort that helps children and families access nourishing food in the Philippines.
hero.imageAlt: Community members sharing ideas around a table

story.label: Our purpose
story.title: Food support with dignity at its heart.
paragraphs: Oksyo is focused on a simple, urgent need: making nourishing meals more accessible to children and people facing food insecurity.

Our approach brings together local ingredients, volunteers, and community partners. By listening to the people closest to each neighborhood, we can shape food support around real needs and deliver it with respect.

leadership.name: John Harold Mejia
leadership.description: John leads Oksyo's community feeding mission, bringing people together around practical food support for children and families in the Philippines. The work is guided by listening, dignity, and care for the communities it serves.
leadership.crewTitle: A crew that makes care practical.

crewRoles.text: Build relationships with neighborhood leaders and listen to families about local needs.

crewRoles.title: Meal preparation
crewRoles.text: Coordinate ingredients, food safety, and thoughtful preparation with volunteers.

crewRoles.title: Volunteer coordination
crewRoles.text: Bring people together and help each community activity run smoothly.

commitment.imageAlt: Community members gathered around a table
commitment.title: Good food should bring people together, not leave anyone behind.
commitment.description: We want every part of our work, from sourcing to serving, to reflect care for people and the places we share.

principles.label: What guides us
principles.title: The way we show up matters.

items.title: Nutritious by design
items.text: We believe meals should be satisfying, balanced, and prepared with care.

items.title: Community first

items.title: Thoughtful sourcing
